what: PreCompact CONFIRMED: no way to give agent an agentic turn before/during compaction. This is a documented Claude Code architectural limitation (agent loop is async to compaction timer). v2.1.105 PreCompact support only added blocking (cancel compaction), not agentic turns. systemMessage is user-facing only, agent doesn't see it. continue field = stop Claude entirely, not "give agent a turn." GitHub issue #32062 requests auto-save before compaction. Post-compact SessionStart save prompt adds minimal value — agent only has summary, Stop hook already saved during session. Keep PreCompact as cleanup-only, remove post-compact save prompt (keep preferences/guidelines injection).
why: Exhaustive research confirmed with sources: GitHub issues, docs, release notes. No mechanism exists. File feature request referencing #32062.
